notes: Original EffectCraft behavior presets (MIT OR Apache-2.0), written from scratch. Each one drives a transform property or opacity with a time-based expression built on the property's own value, so the motion runs for the layer's whole duration and still follows the property's keyframes. Apply to any layer; no effects are added.

presets.name: Soft Wiggle
presets.description: The layer wanders gently around its position.

presets.name: Shake
presets.description: A fast, tight shake of the layer's position.

presets.name: Float
presets.description: The layer bobs up and down like it floats on water.

presets.name: Sway
presets.description: The layer sways left and right.

presets.name: Orbit
presets.description: The layer travels round a circle around its position.

presets.name: Figure Eight
presets.description: The layer traces a figure eight around its position.

presets.name: Bouncing Ball
presets.description: The layer bounces up from its position again and again.

presets.name: Drift Right
presets.description: The layer drifts steadily to the right.

presets.name: Drift Diagonal
presets.description: The layer drifts slowly down and to the right.

presets.name: Pendulum
presets.description: The layer swings like a pendulum.

presets.name: Wobble
presets.description: The layer rotates with an irregular wobble.

presets.name: Spin Slow
presets.description: The layer rotates once every ten seconds.

presets.name: Spin Fast
presets.description: The layer rotates twice a second.

presets.name: Pulse
presets.description: The layer swells and shrinks smoothly.

presets.name: Heartbeat
presets.description: Two quick beats, then a rest, repeating every second.

expr.transform/scale: var t = time % 1; var b = t < 0.3 ? Math.sin(t/0.3*Math.PI) : (t < 0.6 ? 0.7*Math.sin((t-0.3)/0.3*Math.PI) : 0); var k = 1 + 0.2*b; [value[0]*k, value[1]*k]

presets.name: Breathe
presets.description: The layer slowly grows and settles back.

presets.name: Rubber Band
presets.description: Width and height stretch against each other.

presets.name: Jitter Scale
presets.description: The layer's size jitters randomly.

presets.name: Blink
presets.description: The layer switches on and off twice a second.

presets.name: Strobe
presets.description: The layer flashes on for a few frames each beat.

presets.name: Flicker
presets.description: The layer's opacity flickers like a failing lamp.

expr.transform/opacity: var w = wiggle(14, 45); Math.max(0, Math.min(100, w))

presets.name: Fade Pulse
presets.description: Opacity breathes between full and a third.
